NAME_EN: Multi-directional Bendable Silicone Co-extruded LED Strip IP67 Waterproof
DESCRIPTION_KR: 1. 安装方式：此产品需连接DC24V电压连接。安装方式：建议将此灯带固定在龙骨支架上或者镶嵌在铝型材里进行安装。; 2.产品特点： 这是一款可用于户外.室内的灯带.他的防护等级高达IP67.可放水下三米长时间浸泡.此款产品采用的是气相硅胶.气相橡胶耐高低温（-60°至250°）耐老化（柔韧性卓越的同时还经得住拉扯高抗撕强度（可达40kN/m以上）、高伸长率（700%-800%）且拉伸时不易变白）耐臭氧（抗变黄.抗紫外线.安全环保（无毒无味））透光率高（我们采用的是三色工艺加上气相橡胶的透明性能.使他实现见光不见灯的效果.适用于各个场景）等; 3.应用场景：; 室内：; 家居空间装饰：此灯带的柔软可塑性使其能轻松贴合衣柜、橱柜、吊顶、吧台等家具或墙面轮廓，通过单色灯光营造温馨、浪漫的氛围。其IP67的防护等级适合安装在厨房（防潮）、卫生间（防水）等潮湿环境，食品级硅胶材质更符合家庭使用的安全需求; 商业空间氛围营造：在服装店，灯带可嵌入货架或橱窗边缘，高显色性（Ra90+）能真实还原服装的纹理与色泽，提升商品的视觉吸引力；在酒店大堂、会所，灯带可环绕穹顶、立柱或走廊墙面，通过均匀柔和的光线打造高端、舒适的氛围，增强空间的层次感。; 娱乐与互动场景：KTV、酒吧的天花板、墙面或吧台使用多色RGBW可控硅胶灯带，支持蓝牙APP控制，可实现“呼吸渐变”“彩虹流光”“音乐律动”等100多种动态效果，增强娱乐氛围；儿童房内的灯带可通过APP切换“星空漫步”“森林探险”等场景，结合互动功能激发儿童的想象力。; 户外：; 建筑景观亮化：楼宇、桥梁、酒店、文旅小镇等的轮廓勾勒是霓虹硅胶灯带的经典应用。白天，哑光硅胶外壳与古建筑（如苏州平江路历史街区）、现代建筑（如广州天河CBD）的外立面融为一体，不破坏建筑原貌；夜晚，灯光透过硅胶均匀透出，无颗粒感，能清晰勾勒建筑轮廓，提升夜间景观档次。部分产品支持色温定制（如2700K暖黄光适配古建筑、4000K中性白适配现代商业建筑），满足不同风格的照明需求; 文旅与节庆装饰：户外音乐节、展会、主题公园（如广州长隆度假区）等临时或长期活动场景中，霓虹硅胶灯带的防水（IP67及以上）、耐候（-40℃~60℃）特性使其能应对暴雨、沙尘、高温等恶劣天气。通过DMX512协议或APP控制，可实现灯光编排（如“潮水起伏”“星空闪烁”），与音乐、喷泉等元素联动，营造沉浸式视听体验；节日（如春节、圣诞）期间，灯带可快速安装在树木、帐篷、摊位等场景，打造喜庆的氛围; 道路与公共设施：城市广场、步行街、公路护栏、公交站台的照明与装饰中，霓虹硅胶灯带的低功耗（每米功率10-14.4W）、高光效（110lm/W）特性符合节能要求；其耐候性强，能在-30℃（如东北极寒地区）至55℃（如中东沙漠地区）的环境中稳定工作，使用寿命长（5年以上），减少了维护成本。部分产品支持智能调光（如黄昏自动开灯、黎明自动关灯），进一步提升节能效果; 以上就是本款产品的安装方式及产品特点及场景应用。更多未知区域等君自主开发; 以下是效果图片; 15-20days

DESCRIPTION_KR: The latest flicker-free technology from Kaoyi allows the flicker percentage of our drivers to stay below 2% at all dimming range. With synchronous dimming and synchonous start technology, we are capable of providing the most comfortable lighting experience to our users. One of our flicker-free driver series has a VR designed on the housing for users to manually adjust minimum brightness, ensuring identical performance between mutiple lamps connected. The isolated circuit and third-party certification ensure no safety risks on product design. The extent of compatibility is in inverse proportional to product efficiency. Our efficiency compensation technology recognizes the present situation and automatically compensate when needed; simultaneously, it elevates the efficiency of the driver without affecting its compatibility with dimmers. Our latest drivers adopted pressing terminals and patented fastener. The screwless design allows easy installation with working hours saved. Our patented housing is compatible with 0.75mm²-2.5mm² cables. We have moreover developed a whole new non-dimmable product range with this flicker-free technology this year. The compact size and wide usage in lighting caught a lot of attention. With the dip switches equipped in to switch between 8 current options, these drivers can fulfill many lighting needs, especially for track lights. The in-track models even possess an advantage with only 1/3 of the length comparing to other track light drivers. As the flicker-free technology is gaining more and more attention nowadays for eye protection concerns, we believe there is an upsurge of market need since people are laying more emphasis on health, or say, human centric lighting.

It can be used for decorating the background wall in the living room at home, highlighting the texture and appearance of the wall. It can also be installed on the display walls of commercial places to highlight the displayed goods. Meanwhile, the back of the strip light usually has an adhesive backing, making installation convenient and saving construction time and effort.

DESCRIPTION_KR: The DiM to Warm tuning technology is a method for synchronized modulation of light intensity and color temperature within the CCT limits of this lighting fixture. It provides the coldest temperature at 100% of its luminous flux. As the intensity fades, the luminaire changes the color temperature to more pleasing values. When the setting reaches the minimum luminous flux, the luminaire is able to provide the warmest color temperature. This effect is similar to the behavior of traditional halogen bulbs when subjected to intensity variations. Highly appreciated in domestic environments, hotels, etc., the DiM to Warm effect is the answer to the link that color temperature and the amount of light have with people's comfort and well-being. For those moments of the day when activity starts and high biorhythms are required, a cold and abundant light is adequate. On the contrary, when the activity decreases and it is time to relax, a soft temperature and a strictly necessary amount of light are the desired characteristics.; 15days

NAME_KR: Cyanlite Tunable White HCL LED Panel Light
NAME_EN: Cyanlite Tunable White HCL LED Panel Light
DESCRIPTION_KR: Humans are affected by light not only on a visual level but also on a biological one, which was normally called "inner clock" or circadian rhythm. Mankind has evolved under natural light for millions of years, We rise with the sun and go to sleep when it sets. With the use of electricity, the world seems to never sleep. We spend a lot of time indoors, where we use artificial light. And there is a disconnect between natural and artificial light with regards to intensity, color, and dynamics of light, poor circadian entrainment. This may bring to us some bad effects like headaches, neck or back pains, general fatigue, fatigue in the eye muscles, sleep & alertness problems, disturbance of the hormone system, compromised mood, functioning, well-being, and health…..; What about we use artificial light to imitate natural light. This is where HCL (Human Centric Lighting) has come to place. HCL is a way of bringing the natural changes of light intensity and color temperature indoors by using artificial light in order to imitate natural light. HCL puts humans in the center when developing lighting systems, providing optimized work and living environments.; The Cyanlite™ HCLLED backlite LED panel light conbines the benifit of HCL and backlite technology. It is a solution that could befinit humans for better perfomrance, sleep. health and wellbeing and could fit T15/T24 Lay-On ceiling in standard sizes.  It comes with 2 versions of LPW, i.e. 125lm/W and 100lm/W optional and supplied with non-yellowing lens, nano coated back plate in shape of square for stiffness.The aluminum frame is stylish and fashionable, stable, and with excellent thermal management.; •Applications; •Advantages; 30days

This is where HCL (Human Centric Lighting) has come to place. HCL is a way of bringing the natural changes of light intensity and color temperature indoors by using artificial light in order to imitate natural light. HCL puts humans in the center when developing lighting systems, providing optimized work and living environments.; The Cyanlite™ HCLLED backlite LED panel light conbines the benifit of HCL and backlite technology. DESCRIPTION_KR: The XD-150LS Xenon Arc | Xenon Weathering Resistance| Xenon Lamp Aging Test Chamber is an important means for screening formulations and optimizing product compositions during the scientific research and production process. DESCRIPTION_KR: UV aging test Chamber  (also known as UV accelerated aging test chamber UV weathering aging test chamber, UV aging test machine) is a professional equipment for material weathering test. DESCRIPTION_KR: The water ripple lamp is a new type of dynamic decorative ambient light, featuring the following characteristics:; •  Unique lighting effect: Through optical projection technology, combined with high-power and high-brightness LED illumination, the water ripple glass projects rolling and flowing water ripples as it rotates alternately. This creates a shimmering and undulating light effect on the wall, making it seem as if one is immersed in a world of water, providing a soothing visual experience.; •  Various colors and patterns: Utilizing a single integrated LED light source, a wide range of colors can be freely combined. Some water ripple lights even offer full-color 16-color options and various single-color options such as warm light, white light, blue-green light, etc. The light color and mode can be adjusted through the APP or controller. Some of them can also simulate various natural scenes such as water waves, flames, and auroras.; • Environmental friendliness of structure and materials: Usually composed of an aluminum base with an electrically controlled LED light source, a color filter, and a handcrafted cylindrical glass. The glass cylinder has a shape like flowing water, making each lamp unique. At the same time, recyclable materials such as aluminum and borosilicate glass are used, conforming to the environmental protection concept.; Installation is flexible and diverse: there are various forms such as linear, modular, embedded, and wall-mounted. They can be installed inside lampshades, behind furniture, or on walls, suitable for various indoor and outdoor spaces such as bedrooms, dining rooms, bars, and scenic areas. Some outdoor water ripple lights have waterproof functions, with protection levels up to IP66.; • Intelligent control is convenient: It supports DMX512 protocol, RDM function, etc., and can achieve various modes such as master-slave control, scene control, offline operation, etc. Some even allow remote control via APP, making it easy for users to adjust the lighting effects according to their needs. Some high-end water ripple lights also have features such as electric focusing, lens anti-fogging and self-cleaning.; 7days
